description: Static assertions for helix-cad-gates — geometry Computational Sensor + Gate vs an engineer-signed contract. Encodes the GIÁ TRƯỢT 2026-11-02 lessons: feature counts false-pass without position probes; mass must never gate or be tuned; contract hash-locked; PASS is not a signature.
test_input: check this AI-built STEP of a flanged bushing against its geometry contract

assertions.name: contract_not_reference
assertions.check: gate compares the STEP against a signed geometry contract, not a reference model
assertions.regex: geometry_contract\.json[^\n]{0,120}(ký|signed|đã ký)|(không|NOT|KHÔNG) cần STEP đáp án|không so mô hình mẫu

assertions.name: axis_and_probes
assertions.check: F2 per-axis bbox with axis-swap flag and point probes for mirror / misplacement

assertions.name: probes_mandatory_because_f3_false_pass
assertions.check: states that feature counting alone false-passed and probes are required

assertions.name: param_flex
assertions.check: F4 flexes PARAMS and needs the PARAMS/build contract

assertions.name: mass_info_only
assertions.check: title-block mass is INFO, never gating, never a tuning target

assertions.name: approved_hash
assertions.check: contract locked with --approved-hash against agent self-editing

assertions.name: pass_not_signature
assertions.check: PASS does not replace the engineer/CEO render review and signature

assertions.name: isolated_runner
assertions.check: AI-written model.py runs in an isolated child process with timeout
